jobTitle.title: Job Title
jobTitle.description: The job title or keywords to search for (e.g. 'Data Engineer'). Used in the 'q' query param.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: List of skills or keywords to include in the search. Appended to the search query.

location.title: Location
location.description: Location name (e.g. 'United States', 'New York, NY', or 'Remote'). Dice accepts plain location strings — no geoId needed.

datePosted.title: Date Posted
datePosted.description: Filter jobs by how recently they were posted. Uses Dice native postedDate filter.

jobType.title: Job Type (Employment Type)
jobType.description: Filter by employment type. Uses Dice native filters.employmentType param — very reliable, no post-filtering needed for most cases.

workType.title: Work Type (Workplace Type)
workType.description: Filter by work location type. Uses Dice native filters.workplaceTypes param.

experienceLevel.title: Experience Level
experienceLevel.description: Filter by seniority level. Dice has no native experience filter, so this is embedded in search keywords.

maxJobs.title: Max Jobs to Scrape
maxJobs.description: Maximum number of matching job listings to scrape. Scraper keeps paginating until this count is met.
